facts.text: The House on Sathorn is a preserved neo-classical landmark from 1889 that has been a private residence, a hotel and the Russian Embassy.
facts.excerpt: Housed in a beautifully preserved neo-classical landmark dating back to 1889, the building has evolved from a private residence to a hotel, the Russian Embassy, and today, a treasured part of W Bangkok.

facts.text: The hotel has two parts: the century-old House on Sathorn and a sleek 31-story glass tower.
facts.excerpt: the historical, century-old The House on Sathorn and the sleek 31-story glass tower

facts.text: Paii serves modern Thai seafood at The House on Sathorn.
facts.excerpt: Paii, serving modern Thai seafood in one of Bangkok's most iconic landmarks.

facts.text: Bar Sathorn serves cocktails inspired by the historic mansion, blending Thai culture and local ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Bar Sathorn at The House on Sathorn serves signature cocktails and mocktails inspired by the historic mansion, blending Thai culture, local ingredients, and creative mixology.

facts.text: The outdoor WET pool on the sixth floor is surrounded by lounge chairs, couches and covered day beds.
facts.excerpt: Situated on the sixth floor, our inviting 206-square-meter outdoor pool is an urban oasis surrounded by lounge chairs, couches, and covered day beds.

facts.text: The pool has in-pool LED lights in bold hues and underwater music.
facts.excerpt: highlight in-pool LED lights that emit a spectrum of bold hues while underwater music adds to the enchanting ambiance

facts.text: AWAY Spa on the sixth floor has four zones.
facts.excerpt: Experience rejuvenation across four zones in the sixth-floor spa

facts.text: Rooms and suites have touchscreen lighting controls to set the mood.
facts.excerpt: Use a touchscreen to illuminate your room or suite and match one of Bangkok's many playful moods.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is a top-floor corner suite with a whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: 1 Bedroom Presidential Suite, 1 King, Corner room, Top floor, Whirlpool

facts.text: The Whatever/Whenever service can arrange a banquet cruising the Chao Phraya River or a helicopter ride over temples and skyscrapers.
facts.excerpt: An indulgent banquent while cruising the Chao Phraya River? A helicopter ride over traditional temple sprites and skyscraper tips?

facts.text: The hotel is near the BTS SkyTrain's Chong Nonsi Station.
facts.excerpt: All of Bangkok is within reach from our hotel near the BTS SkyTrain & Bangkok's Chong Nonsi Station

facts.text: The hotel grows organic vegetables on its rooftop using compost from its kitchens.
facts.excerpt: By composting food waste from the hotel's kitchens and transforming it into nutrient-rich soil, the hotel is able to grow fresh, organic vegetables directly on the rooftop.

facts.text: The House on Sathorn Heritage Tour explores the building's history.
facts.excerpt: Explore the architectural masterpiece and discover the stories that have shaped this historical building over the years.

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Sathorn.
facts.excerpt: Experience luxury liberated in the vibrant heart of Sathorn at W Bangkok.

facts.text: The pool and fitness center are reserved for in-house guests.
facts.excerpt: Both are on the 6th floor and reserved for in-house guests only.

facts.text: One pet up to 18 kg is allowed per room.
facts.excerpt: One pet is allowed per room, with a maximum weight of 18.0 kgs.

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
